news.title: Berchilay earns Australia call-up to inaugural U-15 World Cup
news.lede: Local talent Ater Berchilay has been selected to represent Australia in the first FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival in Azerbaijan this October. Berchilay’s appearance in the National Select Squad caps off an impressive 2026 campaign for the O’Connor Knights player , in which he won Capital Football’s NPL Boy’s U-15s Player of the Year and the Grand Final Player of the Match. In 2025, the young attacker was named the Knights’ Players’ Player and finished as the club’s top goalscorer, as well as claiming another Grand Final win, this time with the NPL Boys U-14s. Football Australia has only recently established an U-15s outfit, in line with the establishment of FIFA’s new tournament, set to debut in Baku this October for boys, before the girls’ competition takes place in 2027.

news.title: England break down stubborn Czechs to claim first Nations League win
news.lede: Anthony Gordon and Harry Kane were on target again as England saw off 10-man Czech Republic 2-0 to get their Nations League campaign up and running on Tuesday. Thomas Tuchel's side lost an entertaining opener 3-2 against world champions Spain at Wembley on Saturday while the Czechs were beaten by Croatia. The home team kept England at bay in the first half at the Fortuna Arena despite being a man down but Gordon broke the deadlock shortly after the break and Kane gave England a cushion. Tuchel made four changes to his starting line-up from the weekend, bringing in Real Madrid defender Trent Alexander-Arnold for his first start in almost two years.

news.title: United States captain Ream retires from international football
news.lede: Charlotte FC defender Tim Ream captained the US side at the 2026 FIFA World Cup tournament on home soil. MISSOURI - United States captain Tim Ream, 38, retired from international football on Sept 29, having earned 86 caps and won two CONCACAF Nations League titles. Charlotte FC defender Ream captained the US side at the 2026 FIFA World Cup tournament on home soil, where they reached the round of 16 before being eliminated by Belgium. I’m proud of being part of something for 16 years, but it is time to step away from the national team,” the former Fulham and Bolton Wanderers player told reporters ahead of a friendly match against Chile in his hometown of St Louis, Missouri.

news.title: Mizzou football's Kitchen and Smith questionable with injury
news.lede: 25 Mizzou football edge rushers Darris Smith and Langden Kitchen are questionable for Saturday's homecoming game against No. 8 Florida, head coach Eli Drinkwitz said Tuesday. Smith exited the game against Troy in Week 3 with a lower-leg injury and did not play against Mississippi State. Kitchen left last week against the Bulldogs with a lower-body injury and did not return.

news.title: Tim Ream, USMNT World Cup captain, retires from international football
news.lede: Tim Ream announces USMNT retirement after 2026 World Cup. USMNT youngsters bring "contagious" energy to Chile test. Ainhoa Marín called up by Spain, Real Sociedad forward among new faces for United States friendlies. USMNT youth revolution forges ahead in record fashion.

news.title: Yamal inspires Spain to Croatia romp on World Cup homecoming
news.lede: SEVILLE: Lamine Yamal scored two goals and set up another as Spain hammered Croatia 4-1 on Tuesday in the Nations League in their first home game since lifting the World Cup. Yamal, 19, was joined on the scoresheet by Marc Pubill and Nico Williams as they extended their unbeaten run to 40 matches, which includes June’s final triumph over Argentina in the United States. La Roja next play Czech Republic on Saturday in Group A3. Yamal’s contribution strengthened his case for the Ballon d’Or, with voting having closed on Monday and the winner announced on October 26.

news.title: UEFA President Čeferin criticizes Infantino’s approach to football governance — Korea Herald
news.lede: In Copenhagen, Denmark, UEFA President Aleksander Čeferin sharply criticized FIFA President Gianni Infantino at the general assembly of European Football Clubs. He said that football does not need “emperors” and that leaders of football bodies should be stewards of the game, not its owners. Korea Herald reports on Čeferin’s speech. The UEFA chief compared Infantino to the emperor in Hans Christian Andersen’s fairy tale “The Emperor’s New Clothes” and stressed that comfortable words do not change an uncomfortable reality.

news.title: Nations League roundup: Lamine Yamal sinks Croatia in Spain’s World Cup homecoming
news.lede: Teenager scores twice in 4-1 win to boost Ballon d’Or case. Slovenia beat North Macedonia; Faroe Islands hold Moldova. Lamine Yamal scored two goals and set up another as Spain hammered Croatia 4-1 on Tuesday in the Nations League in their first home game since lifting the World Cup. Lamine Yamal had opened the scoring within two minutes against England in Saturday’s Wembley win and took just 75 seconds to do so against Slaven Bilic’s side in Andalusia.
